feeds.title: OSV News
feeds.description: OSV News is a national and international wire service reporting on Catholic issues and issues that affect Catholics. Our mission is to champion the Church in its mission of evangelization by providing subscribers with excellent, accurate, and faithful content that forms, informs, and inspires.

feeds.title: Catholic News Agency » Vatican
feeds.description: Catholic News Agency provides free, up-to-the-minute news affecting the Universal Church, giving particular emphasis to the words of the Holy Father and happenings of the Holy See.

feeds.title: National Catholic Register
feeds.description: Catholic news of the day as seen through the eyes of the Magisterium. National Catholic Register also includes edifying feature articles on such topics as the Culture of Life, Catholic education, books, arts, food & entertainment, Catholic travel, and more.

feeds.title: Catholic Exchange
feeds.description: Catholic Exchange is a non-profit media organization that seeks to bring the Good News of Jesus Christ as proclaimed by the Catholic Church.

feeds.title: ZENIT
feeds.description: ZENIT is an international, non-profit news agency staffed by a team of professionals and volunteers who are convinced that the extraordinary wisdom of the Pontiff and the Catholic Church can nourish hope, and assist all of humanity to find truth, justice and beauty.The coverage we offer focuses on The Pope's activities like apostolic trips, documents, meetings with state officials, and more.

feeds.title: America Magazine
feeds.description: America Media is the leading provider of editorial content for thinking Catholics and those who want to know what Catholics are thinking. America Media leads the conversation about faith and culture by producing excellent, unique, relevant, and accessible content across multiple platforms.

feeds.title: Catholic Culture
feeds.description: CWN provides reliable world news and commentary from a Catholic perspective, available exclusively at CatholicCulture.org. The mission of CatholicCulture.org is to give faithful Catholics the information, encouragement, and perspective they need to become an active force for renewal in the Church and in society, working to shape an authentically Christian culture in a secular world.

feeds.title: The Remnant
feeds.description: The Remnant has been fighting against the revolution in the Church for over forty years, just as it has been fighting against the errors that infect the modern state-- Liberalism, Socialism, Communism, the New World Order, a degenerate youth culture, the abortion epidemic, euthanasia, sex education, etc.

feeds.title: Orange County Catholic
feeds.description: OC Catholic is the official news source of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange. It is published weekly on Sundays and covers a variety of topics related to the Catholic faith, including local news, events, and faith formation. The website also features a radio station, OC Catholic Radio, which broadcasts Catholic programming 24 hours a day. OC Catholic is a valuable resource for Catholics in Orange County and beyond.

feeds.title: LiCAS.news
feeds.description: At LiCAS.news, we write for the governed, not the governors. We tell the stories of those on the fringe of society with empathy and respect. We shine the spotlight in the darkness of the disadvantaged and neglected. We are there to give voice to the voiceless.

feeds.title: Crisis Magazine
feeds.description: Crisis Magazine explores and articulates the subjects of politics, business, culture, faith, and family life from a Catholic perspective.

feeds.title: Catholic Culture News
feeds.description: Respected, trusted, and faithful Catholic commentary, news, liturgical year, and cultural resources. Catholic Culture is a chief provider and curator of Catholic information on the web since 1996.

feeds.title: Vatican News
feeds.description: Sharing news about the activities of Pope Francis and the Vatican, and the life of the Church in the world.

feeds.title: Catholic Online
feeds.description: Catholic Online is a place where you find saints, prayers, the bible, daily readings, catholic news, and everything about Catholic.

feeds.title: The Catholic Review News
feeds.description: Delivering the latest news on all things happening in the Catholic community. The Catholic Review is the official news outlet of the Archdiocese of Baltimore.

feeds.title: The Pillar
feeds.description: News and analysis covering the Catholic Church. The Pillar is a Catholic media project focused on smart, faithful, and serious journalism, from committed and informed Catholics who love the Church.

feeds.title: Indian Catholic Matters
feeds.description: A new home for the Indian Catholic Community. A self funded not-for-profit initiative by two anonymous and passionate catholics.

feeds.title: The Irish Catholic
feeds.description: The Irish Catholic is Ireland's biggest and best-selling religious newspaper. The newspaper, published weekly, provides a lively mix of news, analysis, and informed commentary about the Church and social issues as they affect Ireland and the wider world. Check out their blog and learn more about the latest news, reviews, services, products, and more.

feeds.title: Catholic Journal
feeds.description: Stay tuned to know everything on catholic religion. Get the latest news, views and opinion at your fingertips.

feeds.title: The Catholic Weekly
feeds.description: The Catholic Weekly Newspaper informs, inspires and connects Australian Catholics through expert journalism and insightful commentary. We strive to share our vision of the Church, the Lord and the life-changing possibilities of the Christian path with our readers, providing a degree of Catholic clarity for complex times. We offer news of the Church at every level - from the parish to the world.

feeds.title: Catholic Telegraph
feeds.description: Welcome to The Catholic Telegraph, the monthly magazine of the Archdiocese of Cincinnati. We are one of the oldest newspapers in the United States, published continuously since 1831. Currently 133,000 subscribers receive the magazine in their mailboxes each month, and this website is another way in which we hope to continue our mission of proclaiming the Good News of our Catholic faith.

feeds.title: The Central Minnesota Catholic
feeds.description: Get to know everything about catholic religion at The Central Minnesota Catholic magazine.

feeds.title: Aleteia
feeds.description: The world from a Catholic perspective. Aleteia is a worldwide network providing daily content designed to inspire readers in their daily life.

feeds.title: The Catholic Sun
feeds.description: The Catholic Sun shares in the mission of evangelizing the Catholic faithful by providing news, information, education, a forum for discussion, and guidance in matters of faith, morals and spiritual life.

feeds.title: Catholic Digest
feeds.description: For over 75 years, Catholic Digest connects with readers through personal stories of triumphs and struggles, joys and challenges, and also the lighter side of Catholic living.

feeds.title: US Catholic Magazine
feeds.description: U.S. Catholic puts faith in the context of everyday life, with a strong focus on social justice. For almost 90 years U.S. Catholic has been a courageous, forward-thinking forum for discussion among a broad range of voices.

feeds.title: The North Star Catholic
feeds.description: The North Star Catholic is the official newspaper and news website of the Archdiocese of Anchorage-Juneau.

feeds.title: Catholic Courier
feeds.description: Disseminating timely, compelling, trustworthy information about the Catholic faith, the church, the Diocese of Rochester, parishes & charitable works. The Catholic Courier focuses its coverage primarily on people, ministries, issues, and church life within the Diocese of Rochester in order to engage and inform the readers.

feeds.title: Angelus News
feeds.description: Angelus is your source for Catholic news, analysis, and commentary from Los Angeles, the nation's largest archdiocese and most culturally diverse Catholic community.

feeds.title: UCA News
feeds.description: UCA News is the most trusted independent Catholic news source from Asia. It reports news from, about, and of interest to the Church in Asia.

feeds.title: NZ Catholic
feeds.description: The NZ Catholic website aims to help you keep abreast of Catholic news worldwide. To communicate the Good News of the Gospel, and provide a Catholic perspective on current and relevant issues, by informing and educating New Zealand Catholics about what is happening in the Church and society, both nationally and internationally, with the aim of fostering an informed Catholic community.

feeds.title: CathNews
feeds.description: CathNews reports news about and of interest to the Catholic Church. This Catholic News has focus on New Zealand and the South Pacific.

feeds.title: Catholic World Report
feeds.description: Catholic World Report is an online news magazine that tells the story from an orthodox Catholic perspective. CWR provides full coverage of the news and events affecting the Church around the world, asking questions and examining issues the mainstream media avoids.

feeds.title: The Wanderer
feeds.description: The Wanderer, a national Catholic weekly journal of news, commentary, and analysis, has been publishing continually since 1867. Owned and operated by Catholic laymen, The Wanderer is independent of ecclesiastical oversight but maintains a fiercely loyal adherence to Catholic doctrine and discipline, catholic news,pro life, orthodox, traditional, conservative, Catechesis and Apologetics.

feeds.title: Catholic Herald
feeds.description: The Catholic Herald is Britain's leading Catholic magazine. Breaking news and opinion from the online edition of Britain's leading Catholic newspaper.

feeds.title: CathNews
feeds.description: CathNews is Australia's leading Catholic news service, which delivers news, features, prayers, opinions, reflections, discussion, and Mass on Demand, aggregated from Australia and around the world, every weekday.

feeds.title: The B.C. Catholic
feeds.description: The B.C. Catholic is the official newspaper of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Vancouver. They tell stories that reveal the heart of Jesus Christ and draw people to his Church.

feeds.title: Today's Catholic
feeds.description: Today's Catholic newspaper and its website are important channels of spreading the Gospel and connecting Catholics to one another and the church. Pope Francis has said that diocesan publications 'can represent significant places of encounter and attentive discernment for lay faithful involved in the social and political arena.'

feeds.title: The Catholic Register
feeds.description: Canada's Catholic news source since 1893. The Catholic Register, Canada's oldest English Catholic weekly in Canada. Our mission is to provide intelligent, comprehensive, and faith-filled journalism and to ensure that the views of Catholics and our Church are proclaimed in a way to inform and influence our media and policy makers.

feeds.title: National Catholic Reporter
feeds.description: National Catholic Reporter brings you independent reporting on the Catholic church and justice issues since 1964.

feeds.title: The United States Conference of Catholic Bishops
feeds.description: View the latest news and updates on Bishops and Catholicism through the USCCB Newsroom. The United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (USCCB) is a national membership organization drawing Bishops together to promote the greater good of the Catholic Church.

feeds.title: Florida Catholic
feeds.description: News from Florida's oldest and most trusted Catholic news source. The Florida Catholic educates and inspires its readers and enriches their lives.
